name: Real Estate Simulator 2
detailed_description:
💰From ruins to riches in real estate

The sequel to REAL ESTATE 2 takes things up a notch. Step into the role of a real estate entrepreneur, with no loading screens between locations. 💼 Buy rundown properties, clean and renovate them with your own hands, then furnish and sell for profit.

Drive your vehicle 🚚 to deliver furniture, manage your projects 🛠️, and adapt to a dynamic day/night cycle 🌙 and changing market 📈. Every choice shapes your path to success.

🧹Fix it, Furnish it, Flip it - Business management in detail!In REAL ESTATE 2, you’re not just flipping homes - you’re building an empire from dust. 🏚️ Step into abandoned, trash-filled apartments and bring them back to life with your own hands. Clean up, scrub grime 🧽, repair broken walls - and transform ruins into dream homes.

Every project is yours from start to finish. Pick the furniture, choose the style, create a space that sells. From cozy studios to luxury lofts - every detail matters, every upgrade adds value.

🚚 You’ve got wheels now! Buy a van, load it up, and deliver furniture across a seamless city - no loading screens, no limits. Want to work by night or schedule showings in the daylight? 🌙 With a full day/night cycle, the city breathes and shifts around you.

The market is alive. 📈 Prices change, demand rises and falls - adapt fast or lose to competitors. Analyze trends, grab hot deals, and flip smart.

REAL ESTATE 2 gives you total control: logistics, design, timing, and sales - all in a rich, semi-open world. Clean, plan, furnish, deliver, profit - and rise to the top. 💼🔥

💼 Your Empire Awaits!

REAL ESTATE 2 isn’t about easy wins - it’s about hands-on hustle. Clean, restore, and outsmart the market to turn ruins into riches. 🔥

No shortcuts - just smart moves, hard work, and the drive to build your empire. 💥 Wishlist REAL ESTATE 2 now and be the first to shape the city your way! 🏙️✨

short_description: Real Estate 2 is a continuation of the business simulator, where you completely manage the real estate business, but wider and with more opportunities. Find the best deals, repair, organize transportation and sell with maximum profit. It's time to build your empire!

Minimum:

  • Processor: i3
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1060
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: i7
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 3060
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
